title: kb-tests-windows runs on the project's docker-windows runner
goal: kb-tests-windows in .gitlab-ci.yml targets the project runner (tags [docker-windows]) with a Windows Server 2025 (ltsc2025) image, installs what the tests need there (Python per .python-version through uv, Git with its sh on PATH last), keeps when: manual, allow_failure: true and interruptible: false, and no longer names the hosted saas-windows runner; kb/_self/git.md describes the job as it now runs, and the job has run on main to pytest's summary line.
notes: The operator chose to retarget kb-tests-windows from GitLab.com's hosted Windows runner to the project's docker-windows runner: each job runs in a fresh ltsc2025 container under Hyper-V isolation, Windows PowerShell 5.1, with no Python or Git in servercore; jobs run one at a time and stay pending while the runner is offline. Keep the file's conventions (every job manual, no job writes to the repository). Answers the ci_quota_exceeded failures that held ST-vtlw7fsu and TK-5vfbfjht.
